apps.subtitle: Wii U emulator - experimental test builds
apps.localizedDescription:
MuffinEMU is a Wii U emulator for iPhone and iPad (iOS 15 and later), built on Cemu.

- Import games from Files: WUA, decrypted games, and encrypted dumps with your own keys.txt. DLC and updates install from the app.
- Metal renderer by default, with Vulkan through MoltenVK as an option.
- Runs on the interpreter out of the box, and on the faster recompiler when a JIT enabler such as StikDebug is attached.
- An on-screen GamePad laid out from a real Wii U GamePad, with an optional analog stick, skins and a layout editor. Hardware controllers work alongside it.
- Single screen, both screens, or the TV image on an external display.
- Save states, graphic packs, and 31 app icons with matching themes.

These are unfinished test builds, published by hand to try out work in progress. Each one replaces an installed MuffinEMU: it has the same bundle identifier as the standard build, so your games, saves and settings carry over. They can crash or misbehave. For normal play use the Stable source instead.

Bring your own games and keys. No copyrighted content is distributed here.

versions.localizedDescription:
Experiment: Save states (same-session loads)
Branch: feature/save-states-stage0
Commit: 1a9129e
Based on: main `492ce96` (v7.2), plus 3 commit(s) on the branch
Published: 2026-10-06 20:20 UTC

- Loading a save state now tells you exactly why it was refused, with an error code, and only says "loaded" once the game is drawing again.
- Loading a save state brings the graphics back in step with the restored game, and no longer gives up when the game is waiting on the screen to refresh.
- Loading a save state works after the game has started or stopped background tasks, and timers and sleeping threads carry on from where they were.

Experiment: Favour performance
Branch: feature/favour-performance
Commit: 5598a43
Based on: main `fd4fadf` (v6.7), plus 50 commit(s) on the branch
Published: 2026-10-06 01:14 UTC

- Reset settings to defaults now also resets moved on-screen buttons and the Preview pad, and Let MuffinEMU choose again on the Emulated Clock now really returns to automatic.
- Settings sections are reordered so related options sit together and About is last.
- Playing Splatoon no longer turns on the on-screen sticks and the two-screen layout for your other games.
- Game options now show what each setting follows, say when changes apply, and can be reset to the global defaults in one tap.
- The performance overlay and notification text colour is now chosen with a colour picker instead of a hex code you could not type.
- Settings wording is clearer about what each option does and when it applies, and MoltenVK only shows when Vulkan is selected.
- Settings now explains why Account and Network Service are dimmed during a game, and when the Preview pad is being overridden by another control style.
- The Theme row in Settings now shows which theme is active, and the locked pro icon message points to Settings > Premium.
- The TV and GamePad volume sliders now work, including while a game is running.
- Turning on only VRAM usage or Debug in the overlay now shows it.
